name: killteam-campagne
description: Application de gestion d'une campagne narrative Kill Team (règles inspirées de Trench Crusade).

scripts.build: npm run data:check && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke:online: npm run build:online-test && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ktc "node scripts/smoke-online.cjs"
